name: dirt-mcp
description: Self-hosted passkey dashboard and authenticated MCP access to live Minecraft worlds

scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run validate:openapi && pnpm run test
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:code && pnpm run lint:shell && pnpm run lint:workflows && pnpm run lint:markdown
scripts.lint:code: oxlint mcp-server/src mcp-server/vite.config.ts --type-aware --ignore-pattern 'mcp-server/src/generated/**' && oxlint mcp-server/test scripts/*.mjs
scripts.validate:openapi: redocly lint protocol/openapi.yaml protocol/access-control.openapi.yaml --lint-config=error && pnpm run check:openapi-types
